signIn.lockout: Not possible: no administrator could sign in afterwards.

wizard.title: Add provider

presets.ldapDescription: Sign-in with directory user name and password

fields.name: Key

fields.tenantHint: Overview page of the app registration in Entra ID.
fields.hostedDomainHint: Only accounts of this domain can sign in.
fields.clientSecretHint: Stored encrypted. Leave empty for public clients (PKCE only).

wizard.verifyOidc: Register the redirect URI at the identity provider, then test the connection.

roleMapping.title: Role mapping
roleMapping.enabledDescription: At every sign-in through an identity provider the role is determined from the groups. Roles set by hand are overwritten for these users.
roleMapping.rulesHint: Group as the provider reports it: Entra ID object ID, LDAP group DN, OIDC group name. Case does not matter.
roleMapping.noRules: No rules yet. Everyone gets the default role.
roleMapping.lastAdminHint: The last active administrator is never demoted at sign-in.
roleMapping.duplicate: Each group can only have one rule per provider.
roleMapping.testDescription: Which role would a sign-in with these groups get (saved rules)?
roleMapping.testOff: Role mapping is off; roles stay as they are.

scim.title: SCIM provisioning
scim.enabledDescription: Your identity provider (Entra ID, Okta) creates, updates and deactivates users and pushes groups.
scim.endpointDescription: Enter it at the identity provider as tenant URL or SCIM base URL.
scim.tokensDescription: The identity provider sends a token as bearer token. Only its hash is stored, so a token is shown once.
scim.noTokens: No tokens yet. Create one for each identity provider.
scim.copyNow: Copy the token now and enter it at the identity provider as secret token. It will not be shown again.
scim.revokeDescription: Requests with this token fail at once. Provisioning stops until the identity provider has a new token.
scim.linkingDescription: Provisioned users sign in through a provider. Selected providers may link the first sign-in to the provisioned account by its verified e-mail address.
scim.noProviders: No sign-in provider is set up yet.
scim.groupsHint: Groups appear as provider “SCIM” in the role mapping and in shared mailboxes. Deactivating a user ends all sessions at once; deleting removes the user with all their data, shared mailboxes stay.

users.title: Users
users.noMailAccess: Administrators manage accounts but never see other people's mail.
users.lockout: Not possible: no administrator could sign in afterwards. First make another user an administrator.
users.roleManaged: Role mapping is on: roles of users who sign in through an identity provider are set at their next sign-in.

self.warning: You lose access to the admin area immediately and cannot undo this yourself.

inviteSheet.title: Invite user
inviteSheet.description: Creates a local account. Pass the link on; the person sets their own password.

inviteSheet.localDisabled: Local sign-in is disabled; invited users could not sign in.

delete.description: {{name}} ({{email}}) will be deleted immediately with all of their own data. This cannot be undone.

items.digests: Digests with audio files and podcast feed

delete.kept: Team mailboxes are kept; only this user's assignment is removed. The mails stay in the mail accounts at the provider. The audit log keeps an entry without name and address.

delete.confirmLabel: To confirm, enter the e-mail address {{email}}

digest_days.label: Digests
digest_days.description: Summaries with audio files. At least one day.
